text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At a neighborhood festival, I spotted
Narita Brian at a shooting gallery.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —All right.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
A-Another hit?! That girl is amazing!
Isn't she gonna take every single prize?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Impressive. Come to think of it, Brian,
you've always been good at shooting galleries
since we were kids.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: And conversely, you were terrible at it, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well... yes—

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
All right! Another hit~!
Next is that giant monster!

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Why won't that piggy bank
fall over! Let me readjust the impact point
one more time...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's not as though I aimed for difficult targets,
yet for some reason, you were the only one taking prize
after prize while aiming exclusively for the big ones.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You overcomplicate things with theory. Distance this,
angle that... You've always been too big-headed.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wha—?! Whose head are you calling big?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Be quiet.
...This next one is the last prey.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Taking down a target...
isn't something you do with theory.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You find the most fragile point by instinct—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —And shoot it down!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The fired cork cleanly knocked down the prize.

text_block_list.name: Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
Man, you're putting me out of business...
Well, nothing I can do. Go ahead and take
everything you knocked down, don't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Don't need it. I have no interest in prey once it's taken down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Though, I'll take just the last one
I knocked over.

text_block_list.name: Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
You sure that's all you want...?
Well, come back and play again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Sis. Take it.
...Here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What is this, all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...A piggy bank...? It looks familiar somehow,
like I've seen this shape before—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...! Brian, don't tell me this is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm heading ahead.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh... You really are quite the little sister.
